description: Keep a note on a surgeon's account record that is not a visit: who decides, what they prefer, when to catch them, what a staff member said. Shared with the rep's team like visits, sent to a connected HubSpot as a note on the contact, and read back with the record (changes_since). For something that happened with the surgeon on a day, use log_visit and its note. Notes that read like patient information are refused.

note.description: The note, without any patient information.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.
